description: Checkout of a paid plan through the T-Bank hosted payment form, the order read used by the return page, and the bank notification endpoint (#389, epic #79). One-off monthly payments only: recurring Charge is #390, the profile billing page #391, НПД receipts #392.

headers.Idempotency-Key: required, UUIDv4 or UUIDv7; a retry with the same key and body returns the same order (the same paymentUrl while it is valid)

endpoints.request: {plan PLUS|PRO, period MONTH}; unknown members are 400
errors: 400 INVALID_REQUEST: malformed body, missing Idempotency-Key, plan FREE|MAX, period other than MONTH

409 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE {capability: billing, reason: DISABLED|NOT_CONFIGURED}: checkout is off (learning.billing.checkout=OFF, or TESTERS and the account is not a tester) or the terminal is not configured
409 BILLING_PLAN_BELOW_CURRENT: the account's current entitlement is a higher plan than the requested one
409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used for a different body
429 RATE_LIMITED: more than learning.billing.checkout-per-hour checkouts of one account in a rolling hour
503 PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Init failed or timed out; the order stays without a payment link and a retry with the same key asks the bank again
notes: The amount is computed by the server from contracts/usage/allowances-v1.json (priceRubPerMonth) minus a pending promo discount that applies to the plan (PromoDiscounts); the browser never sends a price.
paymentUrl is an https URL on an allowlisted T-Bank host (pay.tbank-online.com, securepay.tinkoff.ru, securepay.tbank.ru); the client navigates to it only after checking that.
Opening the same plan twice within the payment link lifetime reuses the open order instead of creating a second one.

errors: 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: unknown order or an order of another account (indistinguishable)
notes: Used by the return page /plans/payment/{orderId}. While the order is PENDING the server may ask the bank (GetState) at most once per learning.billing.refresh-interval per order and apply the bank's answer; the query string T-Bank appends to SuccessURL/FailURL is ignored. The browser never confirms a payment.

endpoints.auth: none (no session, no bearer); authenticity = Token (SHA-256 signature with the terminal password) and TerminalKey, then a GetState re-check
endpoints.request: T-Bank HTTP notification, application/json, at most 16 KiB; see tbank/notification-*.json
endpoints.response: 200 text/plain body exactly OK after the notification was durably processed (including an acknowledged no-op: unknown order, repeated status). Anything else makes the bank retry (hourly for 24 h, then daily for a month).
errors: 400 text/plain: not a JSON object, too large
403 text/plain: wrong TerminalKey or Token (logged without values)
503 text/plain: GetState (at most learning.billing.notification-timeout, 5 s) or the database failed; nothing is recorded, so the bank's retry is processed in full and the reconciler also re-checks

Order.listPriceKopecks: integer, the plan price before the discount
Order.paymentUrl: https URL while status is PENDING and the link has not expired, else null
Order.expiresAt: RFC 3339 UTC: the payment link deadline (RedirectDueDate)
Order.periodStart: RFC 3339 UTC or null (set when PAID)
Order.periodEnd: RFC 3339 UTC or null (set when PAID; the BILLING entitlement validUntil)

statuses.PENDING: the order exists; the bank has not confirmed the payment (includes the internal CREATED before Init succeeded)
statuses.PAID: GetState confirmed CONFIRMED with the order's amount; the BILLING entitlement snapshot billing:{orderId} was accepted in the same transaction
statuses.FAILED: the bank reported REJECTED, AUTH_FAIL, CANCELED, DEADLINE_EXPIRED or ATTEMPTS_EXPIRED, the bank refused Init (a new checkout opens a new order), or the link expired unused; a payment that still arrives (re-checked for 72 hours) is granted
statuses.REFUNDED: a PAID order the bank later reported REVERSED, PARTIAL_REVERSED, REFUNDED or PARTIAL_REFUNDED; access policy is #392 (the entitlement is not withdrawn in B1)
statuses.REVIEW: the bank confirmed an amount that does not match, partly refunded a payment that was never granted, or still reported the payment in progress 72 hours after the link; nothing is granted, the operator reconciles
